GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 1 length and Settled Down last 7 Lengths Two Wide , Made Some Ground to 6 Lengths Two Wide turning, improved only a length or So in straight. [Stewards: Raced keenly for some distance passing 1200m.] # slow out/no threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keen for some distance passing the 1200m when awkwardly placed on heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 2 Lengths and Settled Down last 9 Lengths from the lead, made no ground to turn, Made Some Ground in straight. [Stewards: App. jockey reported it failed to travel early/middle stages and laid in when fully pressured.] # very slowly away
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Rdr reported mount failed to travel in the early and middle stages and when placed under full pressure, laid in for the remainder.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out & Settled Down last 10 Lengths from the lead, railed to 8.5 Lengths turning, Hooked Out widest Straightening Up and Made Ground to the line # ran on fairly late

Jumped okay & Settled Down 7.5 Lengths Four Wide , in Two Wide by 1200m, Hooked Out 3 Wide at 750m, Made Some Ground to 5.5 Lengths 3 Wide turning, Lost Ground in straight. [Stewards: Raced keenly early stages.] # mostly Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping. Raced keen early. Near the 900m, improved onto heels and steadied.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 1.5 Lengths and Dropped Out last 10 Lengths from the lead, little change middle stages, trailed 9 Lengths turning, shifted wider rounding turn, 3-4 Wide Straightening Up and ran on making up fair ground in Straight # slow start no help
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Laid in under pressure over the concluding stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 2 Lengths and Settled Down a long last 13 Lengths from the lead, tacked on middle stages, and moved to within 7 Lengths (still running last) turning, shifted 3 Wide Straightening Up and ridden for luck finding skinny gaps in the field down the running. # slow start costly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin and lost ground. Leaving the 100m tightened for room.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 7 Lengths Two Wide , Made Some Ground to 5 Lengths 3 Wide turning, Lost Ground in Straight # never a factor

Jumped ok off a Wide gate looking to slot in couldn't stuck out 3 Wide no cover out of the Straight 1 Lengths (1600m), crossed to park Outside Leader Soon After , no change whatsoever until Ridden Along 450, Quickly Under Pressure back to 4th Straight Under Pressure , faded Further # early work no help
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr advised not intention to be that far forward, however after being caught wide early, permitted mount to stride to find a position closer to the rail.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 1.5 Lengths and Settled Down 8 Lengths on fence, Made Some Ground to 7 Lengths Two Wide turning, improved rounding turn then swept out widest Straightening Up , ran on hitting Lead at the 100m, kept going to post # solid win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. When the pace eased, improved onto heels near the 1150m, shifted out and raced keenly for a short distance. Leaving the 150m, shifted in abruptly under pressure. Cast the near-hind plate in running.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 1.5 Lengths and then slow into stride, hooked across and Moved Up to settle down 6.5 Lengths on fence, railed to 5 Lengths turning, Hooked Out 3 Wide Straightening Up and Made Ground in Straight # slow start no help

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Hampered at start and then unable to muster speed early. Laid in under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly and Settled Down 6 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 9 Lengths 3 Wide turning, one-paced in straight. (Blinkers (Off Side) FIRST TIME) [Stewards: Jockey opined it may not have appreciated the track conditions. Post-race vet exam revealed no apparent abnormalities.] # never featured
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Rdr reported gelding may not have appreciated track conditions. A post-race vet exam revealed no abs.
